about: Renders keyboard input as keycaps. `Kbd.Group` renders a key combination and sets the size, look and palette of its keycaps.

keys.about: Modifier and named keys at `md`. A one-character key is square.
keys.title: Keys

sentence.about: A combination at `md` inside a line of body text. The keycap is shorter than the line.
sentence.title: In a sentence

shortcuts.about: Commands with their combinations in a 384px room. Each `Kbd.Group` sets `sm` on its keycaps.
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts

title: Kbd

variant.about: Every look at every size. `raised` is the default.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
